    • sqlTypeWithAutoCast

      public static org.apache.beam.vendor.calcite.v1_40_0.org.apache.calcite.rel.type.RelDataType sqlTypeWithAutoCast(org.apache.beam.vendor.calcite.v1_40_0.org.apache.calcite.rel.type.RelDataTypeFactory typeFactory, Type type)
      SQL-Java type mapping, with specified Beam rules:
      1. redirect AbstractInstant to Date so Calcite can recognize it.
      2. For a list, the component type is needed to create a Sql array type.
      3. For a Map, the component type is needed to create a Sql map type.
      4. For standard Java classes (String, Integer, etc.), map them to corresponding Calcite SQL type with appropriate nullability.
      Parameters:
      type -
      Returns:
      Calcite RelDataType
